text: LiteRT-LM's logit masks: MaskType is kBitmap, kSparse, kComposite or kCustom; a BitmapLogitMask stores ceil(vocab/64) 64-bit words (bit set = allowed) and sets disallowed logits, and logits past vocab_size, to -infinity for FP32 or tflite::half::min() for FP16; a SparseLogitMask applies z' = z*w + b per entry (dividing negative logits by w when sign_dependent_weight) and skips logits already at -infinity or half::min(); a CompositeLogitMask fuses its bitmaps with a bitwise AND, then applies custom masks, then sparse ones.
